name: Archmage
focus: One huge hit, built from flammability, Lotus and repeats.
about: Plays for one enormous hit. Fire builds flammability, Lotus turns into one huge blow, and Focus makes skills repeat.
lore: The Archmages of the old Sun Court held that a spell should be spoken once and never answered. They trained to pour a whole ritual into a single word, and their towers still bear the scorch of it.

signature.name: Ember Echo
signature.text:
Echoes the last {fire:fire} skill before it in your ritual, with its hits and effects
Every {fire:Focus} you hold makes the echo {n:20%} stronger {note:(+60% at 3)}
With full {fire:Focus} the echo repeats
Then all your {fire:Focus} is spent

capstones.name: Starfall
Twin Sun
capstones.text:
The costliest skill in each ritual always repeats {note:(the first one on a tie; rites never repeat)}
The repeat's first hit deals {n:100%} more damage

nodes.name: Arcane Focus
nodes.short: Build {fire:Focus}; at {n:3} your next skill repeats
nodes.text:
Every cast that lands without a crit builds {n:1} {fire:Focus}
At {n:3} {fire:Focus} your next skill casts twice, and your {fire:Focus} empties

nodes.name: Pyre Lotus
Second Incantation
nodes.text: Your skills that strike with a single hit gain {n:+10%} chance to repeat

nodes.name: Convergence
nodes.short: {ice:Lotus} gives your first hit {n:100%} more damage
nodes.text:
Spending {ice:Lotus} no longer makes the hit crit
Instead, the skill's first hit deals {n:100%} more damage, and its other hits deal none
Skills of every element can spend {ice:Lotus}, {fire:fire} included

nodes.name: Quick Focus
nodes.text: Your {fire:Focus} is full at {n:2} instead of {n:3}, so your double casts come sooner

nodes.name: Echoing Mind
nodes.text: Your repeats deal {n:45%} more damage {note:(not Shock or Conductive repeats)}

nodes.name: Rime Lens
nodes.short: Rite: a {ice:Lotus} any element can spend
nodes.text:
Unlocks the rite Rime Lens {note:(buff, 2 Charge)}: {n:1} {ice:Lotus} any element can spend
Every {ice:Lotus} you spend also builds {n:1} {fire:Focus}

art.name: Sunfall
art.short: A {fire:fire} pillar and meteors, then the sun falls
art.lore: The Sun Court sealed one spell beneath every tower: the sun itself, asked to fall. No Archmage has spoken it twice.

name: Spellblade
focus: Crits through many hits, built from Momentum and Scar.
about: Plays for crits through many small hits. Momentum sharpens each hit in a cast, and every crit leaves a Scar that makes later crits deadlier.
lore: Spellblades learned magic on the duelling floor, not in the library. They carve their spells into the steel and let the blade speak them, one cut after another, until the enemy is more wound than flesh.

signature.name: Gale Step
signature.short: Signature: a wind-blade dash that spends {physical:Scar}

capstones.name: Flurry of Steel
Thousand Cuts

nodes.name: Blade Dance
Quickening
nodes.text: Your skills that hit more than once strike {n:1} extra time

nodes.name: Open Wound
nodes.text:
With {n:10} or more {physical:Scar}, your crits ignore {n:25%} of the Guardian's armour and resistance
Each of those crits also lowers its elemental resistance by {n:10%} {note:(Resist Shred, 3 casts)}

nodes.name: Keen Rhythm
nodes.text:
Your crits gain {n:+7%} crit damage for every {physical:Momentum} built, that is every earlier hit in the cast
Your ailments gain {n:+8%} effect for every {physical:Momentum} too {note:(bleed, Shock, chill and the rest)}

nodes.name: Blood Edge
Glacial Focus
Riposte
nodes.text: With {n:15} or more {physical:Scar}, every 5th hit adds a slash for {n:160%} of that hit's damage

art.name: Bladestorm
art.short: Spectral swords cut, then one slash that always crits
art.text:
Spectral swords make {n:3} cuts, plus {n:1} for about every {n:4} {physical:Scar} {note:(8 at 20 Scar)}
Then one huge slash that always crits, with {n:+50%} crit damage
All of it strikes in your ritual's main element, as real hits that proc and set off chains
Your {physical:Scar} and {physical:Momentum} start over
art.lore: The duelling floors kept one form off the record: the form where the blade stops waiting for the hand.

name: Warlock
focus: Ignite and poison saved in a bank, set off by Withering Hex.
about: Plays for burn and poison together. Every ignite and poison goes into a bank. Withering Hex sets it all off at once, bigger with each Brimstone.
lore: Warlocks made a pact with the sulfur that sleeps under the Planes. It keeps every burn and every venom they lay, and pays it all back at once when they speak the Hex.

signature.name: Brimstone Rupture
signature.text:
Two bursts erupt on the Guardian, first {fire:fire} then {chaos:poison}, and both strike as {chaos:chaos}
It grows with your {chaos:Brimstone}, up to {n:x2} damage when it is full
Then it spends all your {chaos:Brimstone}, but the bank stays
For your next cast the Guardian is Exposed and takes {n:20%} increased damage

capstones.name: Apocalypse
capstones.text:
The last {chaos:Withering Hex} of each ritual Invokes twice
The first Invoke strikes at {n:×3} strength and keeps the bank
The second spends it as usual
All your Invokes deal {n:350%} more damage

capstones.name: Pandemonium
capstones.short: After an Invoke, {fire:fire} poisons and {chaos:chaos} ignites

nodes.name: Brimstone Pact
Hex Weaver
Venomfire
nodes.text:
A hit that applies {fire:ignite} and {chaos:poison} together gives {n:1} more {chaos:Brimstone}
While both are on the Guardian, their ticks deal {n:30%} increased damage

nodes.name: Smouldering Ruin
nodes.text:
After an Invoke, {n:60%} of the bank stays
Talents that Expose or detonate {chaos:poison} also Invoke, at {n:50%} strength and keeping the bank

nodes.name: Flame of Ruin
nodes.text: Your Invokes deal {n:1.2%} more damage for every {n:1%} {fire:flammability} on the Guardian {note:(+180% at 150%)}

nodes.name: Sulfur Blood
nodes.text:
Hold up to {n:15} {chaos:Brimstone} instead of {n:10}
The bank saves your {fire:ignites} and {chaos:poisons} at {n:110%} of their damage

nodes.name: Festering Hex
nodes.text: While the Guardian is Exposed, each hit that gives {chaos:Brimstone} gives {n:1} more

art.short: A void gate opens and {chaos:chaos} pours out in waves
art.text:
A void gate opens and {n:3} waves of {chaos:chaos} pour through it
They are real hits that can crit, {chaos:poison} and set off your chains
Your bank and {chaos:Brimstone} start over
art.lore: The pact had one clause in small letters: the sulfur may be called up all at once, but the gate does not close politely.

name: Alchemist
focus: Poison stacks pile up, then blast in one hit after the last cast.
about: Plays for a mountain of poison. Stacks never expire and up to 25 pile up. After your last cast they all detonate in one hit.
lore: Alchemists distil patience. Every drop they lay waits, quiet and growing, and when the work is done they light the last flask and let the whole brew answer at once.

signature.name: Volatile Flask
signature.short: Signature: a flask of {n:10} stacks that bursts
signature.text:
Throws a flask that adds {n:10} {chaos:poison} stacks, then bursts once
A quarter of the stacks flare up in the burst, and none are removed
The more stacks the Guardian holds, the harder it bursts {note:(× 1 + stacks ÷ max stacks)}
At full stacks it deals {n:x2} damage

capstones.name: Magnum Opus
capstones.text: The final detonation deals {n:11%} more damage for every {chaos:poison} stack {note:(×3.75 at 25)}

capstones.name: Toxic Apotheosis

nodes.name: Dormant Venom
Virulent Mist
nodes.text:
You gain {n:+90%} {chaos:poison} chance
Hold {n:5} more {chaos:poison} stacks
Your {chaos:poison} deals {n:25%} less damage, but your hits are unaffected

nodes.name: Venom Edge
nodes.text:
On your {physical:physical} skills, your bonus {chaos:poison} chance adds to your {physical:bleed} chance
{physical:Bleed} chance over {n:100%} gives extra bleeds
Every {physical:bleed} you apply also leaves a {chaos:poison} stack worth {n:150%} of it
Bleeds that already turn into {chaos:poison} make that poison deal {n:60%} more damage instead

nodes.name: Overdose
Catalyst

Every {n:10} {chaos:poison} stacks you apply set off a blast
The blast deals {n:40%} of all damage over time on the Guardian, and removes nothing

The final detonation deals {n:25%} more damage

art.short: {n:75} {chaos:poison} stacks of venom, saved for the last detonation
art.text:
Brews {n:75} {chaos:poison} stacks of venom, worth {n:x12.25} {note:(+15% for each stack)}
The venom joins Dormant Venom and goes off after the ritual's last cast
The detonation is (stacks × strongest stack + this venom) × Magnum Opus or Toxic Apotheosis
Your {chaos:poison} starts over
art.lore: Every Alchemist works toward one recipe and hopes never to finish it. The last flask is not poured, it is surrendered.

name: Oracle
focus: A long ritual: 8 slots, cheaper Charge, lasting buffs.
about: Plays for a long ritual: an extra slot, cheaper Charge and three buff rites. Omen keeps your buffs alive longer, and late casts hit hardest.
lore: Oracles read the ritual before it is spoken. They light one candle for every blessing they will need, and when the last candle burns, the future they read comes true.

signature.name: Augury

capstones.name: Prophecy
capstones.text:
After each ritual's last cast, the ritual's strongest cast repeats once
The repeat keeps the buffs that are still active then

capstones.name: Eternal Blessing
capstones.short: Full {chaos:Omen} makes buffs last and grow
capstones.text:
Each time your {chaos:Omen} fills, every active buff lasts {n:1} cast longer and grows {n:15%} stronger
This stacks, and carries into later rituals

nodes.name: Omen
Kindled Will
nodes.text: Unlocks the rite Kindled Will {note:(buff, 3 Charge)}: your next {n:3} casts deal {n:80%} more hit damage

nodes.name: Battle Trance
nodes.text:
Unlocks the rite Battle Trance {note:(buff, 3 Charge)}: your next {n:3} casts gain {n:+70%} increased base damage
{note:Base damage counts before every other bonus, so it raises hits and damage over time alike}

nodes.name: Crescendo
nodes.short: Casts 6 to 8 deal up to {n:+90%} more
nodes.text: The 6th, 7th and 8th casts of a ritual deal {n:30%}, {n:60%} and {n:90%} more hit damage

nodes.name: Harmony
nodes.text:
Your hits deal {n:20%} more damage for every different buff active {note:(+60% with 3)}
This adds to the {n:30%} a buff that Omen gives

nodes.name: Choir
nodes.text: The effects of your rites are {n:10%} stronger

nodes.name: Echo Spark

Every repeat builds {n:1} {chaos:Omen} {note:(not Shock or Conductive repeats)}

art.short: Three foretold strikes in your ritual's main element
art.text:
{n:3} strikes fall on the Guardian in your ritual's main element
They are real hits that can crit, proc and set off your chains
Your {chaos:Omen} starts over
art.lore: Oracles read every future but one. The Last Prophecy is read aloud only when there is no future left to read.

name: Hemomancer
focus: Fire paid for in Ward: every skill builds Blood, and Blood spends itself in one crimson burst.
about: Plays fire, paid for in blood. Each skill pays a little Ward and gains Blood (fire skills twice as much); Blood makes your fire hit harder until Crimson Covenant spends it all. Road A burns with stronger ignites, road B lives on a low Ward. Its skills are drawn a dark purplish red; the elements stay the same.
lore: Hemomancers learned what the Warlocks only bargained for: fire is hungrier than sulfur, and blood keeps it fed. They pay in themselves, a little with every word, and the realm's red moon answers them.

signature.name: Crimson Covenant
signature.short: Signature: spend all {fire:Blood} in one burst

capstones.name: Sanguine Pyre
capstones.text:
Capstone
Once a cast, your first {fire:fire} hit on a burning Guardian makes its {fire:ignite} burst
The burst deals {n:120%} of the {fire:ignite}'s remaining damage at once
The {fire:ignite} keeps burning afterwards

capstones.name: Heartburn
capstones.text:
Capstone
A {fire:fire} cast that begins with full {fire:Blood} becomes a Heartburn
Heartburn deals {n:120%} more damage
Your {fire:Blood} then drops to {n:5}, before the cast's tithe

nodes.name: Blood Tithe
nodes.short: Every skill costs Ward and feeds {fire:Blood}

nodes.name: Bloodfire Hex
nodes.text:
Unlocks the rite {chaos:Withering Hex} {note:(debuff, 2 Charge)}: for {n:3} casts the Guardian takes {n:20%} increased damage from every hit and tick
Your {fire:ignites} burn {n:60%} hotter

nodes.name: Blood Price
Bloodfire
nodes.text: Your {fire:ignites} grow {n:8%} stronger for every {fire:Blood} you hold {note:(+80% at 10)}

nodes.name: Open Veins
nodes.short: The lower your Ward, the harder you hit

nodes.name: Blood Moon
Transfusion
nodes.text: Crimson Covenant gives back half of the {fire:Blood} it spends, so the next burst comes sooner

art.name: Crimson Eclipse
art.short: The world turns red, five slashes from the shadows, a giant bite
art.lore: The first Hemomancer paid for one spell with everything she had left. The moon has been red over the realm ever since.

name: Black Knight
focus: A heavy knight of steel and storm: its Impales stay in the Guardian, and every one is a lightning rod.
about: Plays lightning on Impale. Your Impales stay in the Guardian as Iron, and your lightning hits impale too; each Impale held is a lightning rod that makes your lightning hit harder, until Iron Verdict drives them all home. Road A fills the field with Impales and arcs lightning through them; road B makes your lightning Shock and repeat, and ends each ritual with an Execution Blow.
lore: The Black Knights were the realm's last order of the sword. They forged their lances to call the storm: what they drive into a Guardian stays there, and the lightning follows it in.

signature.name: Iron Verdict

capstones.name: Field of Spears
capstones.text:
Capstone
Once a cast, with full {lightning:Iron}, your first {lightning:lightning} hit arcs through every spear in the Guardian
Each {physical:Impale} you hold strikes for {n:160%} of what it stored, as true damage
The {physical:Impales} stay where they are

capstones.name: Execution Blow
capstones.text:
Capstone
The costliest cast of each ritual becomes an Execution Blow
It deals {n:120%} more damage
If it is {lightning:lightning}, it {lightning:Shock}-repeats once more

Spearwall

name: Assassin
focus: Ice and few hits, each a decisive crit: Intent builds to a Killing Blow, frost shatters the frozen and Death Mark finishes the weak.
about: An ice job on few, heavy crits. Ice skills of 1 to 3 hits crit more often and harder; every hit and crit builds Intent, and a full Intent makes your next hit a sure Killing Blow. Death Mark spends it all on sure ice crits that execute a weak Guardian. Road A freezes the Guardian to shatter it; road B makes the first and the last strike of each ritual count.
lore: Assassins learned in the Moonless Vale that a Guardian is never beaten by the hundredth cut, only by the one that was meant. Their blades are ice, and they wait for that one.
